properties.name: SelectedPumpId
properties.description: Pump shown in the status panel

properties.name: TrendWindowHours
properties.description: Hours of history shown in trends

properties.name: StatusMessage
properties.description: Status line written by scripts and property triggers

scripts.name: Select Pump
scripts.description: Shows another pump in the status panel.
scripts.code:
# Select Pump: show another pump in the status panel.
Document.Properties["SelectedPumpId"] = pumpId

scripts.name: Reset Pump Selection
scripts.description: Selects the first pump of the fleet again.
scripts.code:
# Reset Pump Selection: back to the first pump of the fleet.
Document.Properties["SelectedPumpId"] = "P-101"

scripts.name: Set Alert Threshold
scripts.description: Sets the discharge pressure alert limit.
scripts.code:
# Set Alert Threshold: discharge pressure limit in psig.
Document.Properties["AlertThreshold"] = threshold

scripts.name: Set Trend Window
scripts.description: Sets trend length, event overlay and window start in one call.
scripts.code:
# Set Trend Window: trend length, event overlay and window start in one call.
Document.Properties["TrendWindowHours"] = hours
Document.Properties["ShowEvents"] = showEvents
Document.Properties["WindowStart"] = windowStart

scripts.name: Update Status Message
scripts.description: Rewrites the status line; runs when SelectedPumpId or AlertThreshold changes.
scripts.code:
# Update Status Message: property trigger of SelectedPumpId and AlertThreshold.
pump = Document.Properties["SelectedPumpId"]
limit = Document.Properties["AlertThreshold"]
Document.Properties["StatusMessage"] = ("Pump " + str(pump) + " - alert above "
                                         + str(limit) + " psig")

scripts.name: Open Page
scripts.description: Activates the page passed by the caller.
scripts.code:
# Open Page: activate the page passed by the caller.
Document.ActivePageReference = targetPage

scripts.name: Rename Visual
scripts.description: Sets the title of the visualization passed by the caller.
scripts.code:
# Rename Visual: set the title of the visualization passed by the caller.
visual.Title = newTitle

scripts.name: Describe Table
scripts.description: Writes the row count of a data table into the status line.
scripts.code:
# Describe Table: write the row count of a data table into the status line.
Document.Properties["StatusMessage"] = table.Name + ": " + str(table.RowCount) + " rows"

scripts.name: Log Maintenance Window
scripts.description: Summarises a maintenance slot in the status line.
scripts.code:
# Log Maintenance Window: summarise a maintenance slot in the status line.
parts = ["Ticket " + str(ticketNumber), "on " + str(serviceDate), "at " + str(startTime),
         "for " + str(duration), "cost " + str(cost), "efficiency " + str(efficiency)]
Document.Properties["StatusMessage"] = " ".join(parts)
